title: A social-media feed on your site
oneLine: Show your latest Instagram or X posts on your own website.
why: A documented attempt built this with Claude Code and Airtable, then went back to paying. Social platforms expire your access tokens and rate-limit you, so the thing you build keeps quietly breaking. The building is easy. The owning is not.
tool: Claude Code; a small server that refreshes tokens
keep: Working tokens. Honestly, that's the whole product.
breaks: Tokens expire. APIs change. The author's payback period on this one was about seven years.

sources.label: Signal to Noise: what it was actually like to replace SaaS with Claude Code
